b_cases.name: tool-manifest-runner-qualification
b_cases.property: bench doctor qualifies the pinned libraries, wheel provenance, cgroup counters, thread environment and cpuset; a missing item BLOCKS

b_cases.name: wall-versus-cpu-and-units
b_cases.property: a finite wait has elapsed time without equivalent busy CPU; a bounded compute control consumes measured CPU; ns/us/s and bytes/KiB conversions are exact; resolution and tolerances are declared

b_cases.name: descendant-and-short-lived-worker-cpu
b_cases.property: CPU of spinning children, a native coreutils child and many short-lived children is in the cgroup total

b_cases.name: whole-workload-memory-and-peak
b_cases.property: spec 8.4 errors 2-8: child memory in the group peak, no summed peak, largest waited child, shared pages, sampled lower bound, untouched reservation

b_cases.name: statistics-and-unstable-outcomes
b_cases.property: equal, faster, slower and noisy synthetic datasets, correlated inner samples, missing trials and invalid denominators; insufficient or noisy evidence is INCONCLUSIVE, never retried

b_cases.name: python-concurrency-and-runtime-identity
b_cases.property: thread and process variants with explicit workers, spawn start method and bounded pending work; real result and error handling; GIL state reported after imports where exposed, never impersonated

b_cases.name: measurement-perturbation-and-cache-policy
b_cases.property: timing runs apart from cProfile and memory diagnostics with labels; empty-overhead and no-change controls visible; launch and profiling time never mixed into a variant; host tuning requests rejected; echo-control part in Phase 2

b_cases.name: resource-and-topology-guardrails
b_cases.property: hidden one-CPU availability, oversubscribed workers, unbounded queues, changed nested-library threads or a missing aggregate limit are rejected or blocked before stress; a permitted measured envelope runs; missing multicore capacity is not a fabricated pass

b_cases.name: python-first-decision-engine
b_cases.property: synthetic policies and data exercise keep-Python, optimize-first, Python-library/concurrency, C-candidate, inconclusive and invalid; a faster isolated C kernel with slower caller cost earns no recommendation; missing objectives or approval never authorize migration

b_cases.name: evidence-integrity-and-work-accounting
b_cases.property: stale or cross-run metrics, incorrect cgroup identity, altered raw observations, missing failed attempts, forged self-timing, duplicate rows or wrong work counts are rejected; an unmodified real experiment gives traceable raw and summary records

b_cases.name: starter-child-and-normal-workflow-integration
b_cases.property: bench payload in both starter instances, path with spaces, designated child qualification with real measurement; scaffolding, replay, docs, concurrency policy, metric profiles and runtime exclusion verified; no copied parent measurements or grandchildren

b_cases.name: actual-c-concurrency
b_cases.property: run the real pool with one and at least two workers under an approved multicore envelope; verify task IDs and results, separate worker identities that spent CPU, overlapping execution, bounded concurrency and completion; a serial-dispatch or one-CPU-affinity masquerade fails; no speedup is required

b_cases.name: equal-work-and-correctness-oracle
b_cases.property: a skipped chunk, wrong order or result, missing output, hardcoded answer, or unapproved precision or range change is rejected before it becomes an eligible row; C equals the Python reference on every route; a project adds its own agreement mutations in its protocol

b_cases.name: fair-build-and-resource-context
b_cases.property: reject a comparison with mismatched input or scope, an unannounced algorithm change, a different CPU or memory envelope, instrumented or debug C, a stale library, or different selectors, panels or dataset identities; same-envelope release rows stay comparable

b_cases.name: caller-boundary-and-cold-warm-separation
b_cases.property: execute the stdio, persistent-worker, shared-memory and in-process routes with real framing, copied bytes and caller plus worker accounting under each route label; a scope mutant that omits transport or startup or ends before result receipt is rejected; no route falls back

b_cases.name: c-pool-ownership-and-lifecycle
b_cases.property: admission bounds, completion, drain and teardown, per-task cleanup and error paths through controlled tests labeled simulated; real runs are ASan, UBSan, TSan and MSan clean; seeded race and lifetime mutants fail their checks; no callback outlives its owner

b_cases.name: failure-cancellation-and-cleanup
b_cases.property: bound and classify a worker error, EOF or protocol error, partial response, timeout, a finite crash fixture and a crash in the caller child; reap the whole job; no process or shared-memory segment is left; no incomplete result counts; a normal shutdown keeps results

b_cases.name: measurement-perturbation-and-cache-policy-echo-control
b_cases.property: echo-control rows (every declared C variant, worker count, mode and route) measure the caller boundary with an empty kernel; labeled overhead calibration; the project names its echo case in the protocol

b_cases.name: real-complete-demo-matrix
b_cases.property: execute the Python/C one/multiple-worker matrix, all three scope demonstrations, cold/warm caller paths and independent memory trials through public commands; publish actual numbers even if C loses; synthetic decision tests cannot substitute
